title: Text Transform preset 2: arch: text along the bottom of a circle (reverse arch)
description: HHHHHHH in Lato Bold, 10 mm, centred at (50, 50) mm, with Text Transform preset 2 (arch: text along the bottom of a circle (reverse arch)). OpenStitch's envelope comes from tools/fit_envelopes.py, fitted to PE-DESIGN's files.

evidence.note: compat/reference/text/text-transform-2.pes, PE-DESIGN 11.50 (pe-gui); 26 presets, survey in the text track notes

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (File > New), with Lato Bold (crates/openstitch-design/fonts/Lato-Bold.ttf, OFL) installed for the current Windows user and used as a TrueType font. Text tool, click at (50, 50) mm and type HHHHHHH: Lato, size 10.0 mm, alignment Center, region Fill Stitch in 800 RED with the text's own Sewing Attributes (under sewing off, density 5.0), line Not Sewn. Text Attributes > Transform on, preset 2 of the palette in reading order (the two arches first, then the grid row by row). Keep the text inside the page. Save As PES (default type) as compat/reference/text/text-transform-2.pes and record in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json the PE-DESIGN version, date, OS, the font as PE lists it, the preset and its box (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
